question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this durable review-observability schema and `workflow_run` observer as the supported rollout foundation for the per-item review-sharding work in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674?
rationale: The patch is a new operational contract rather than a narrow established-behavior repair; the correct retention, rollout, and enforcement relationship to the coupled sharding work depends on maintainer ownership of the product and operational direction.

options.title: Sponsor passive foundation
options.body: Merge only after maintainer approval of the passive schema and require a fresh-main canary before any producer enforcement is enabled.

options.title: Keep direction together
options.body: Pause this PR until the maintainers choose the final producer and enforcement contract for the related sharding work, then land a narrower coordinated change.

recommendation.title: Sponsor passive foundation
recommendation.body: Merge only after maintainer approval of the passive schema and require a fresh-main canary before any producer enforcement is enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: They hold the clearest available implementation context across this PR and the explicitly coupled review-sharding proposal.
